title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Juicy Peach Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Juicy Peach Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod delivers a smooth, delicate fruit flavour. Sweet Peach comes through clearly with every inhale, offering a mellow profile that’s light, juicy, and easy to enjoy all day. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that automatically replenishes the pod. Together they provide up to 20,000 puffs depending on your style, with no coil changes or manual refilling needed. Equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod ensures consistent vapour and well-defined flavour throughout. Designed exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re good to go.
